component.name: Atyaf
أطياف
component.summary: Manage independent application profiles on Linux
إدارة ملفات شخصية مستقلة للبرامج على Linux

description.p: Atyaf manages Linux executables and portable applications with independent configuration, data, cache and state paths for each profile.
Launch profiles, inspect process output and create independent application menu shortcuts. Profile separation is not a security sandbox.
